lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg6Cr2Sb2 (reduced formula Mg3CrSb) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: each Cr and Sb has 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 neighbors with varying Mg, Cr, and Sb composition. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cr and Mg polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
